purpose: Non-admission discovery of high-value cross-sector public data and open analytical workflow references for agriculture, insurer reporting, infrastructure logistics and business interruption; no external source-data bytes, admission or model-use rights are granted.

entries.name: IFPRI MapSPAM 2020 v2r2 spatial crop production
entries.spatial_scope: Global gridded agricultural production; output cell estimates do not identify individual farms or insured parcels
entries.temporal_scope: Reference agricultural production year 2020; IFPRI SPAM 2020 version 2 release 2 published in 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 5 arc-minute (~10 km) cell statistics by 46 crop groups, rainfed/irrigated farming, physical and harvested area, production and yield; CSV and GeoTIFF
entries.note: The provider offers MapSPAM 2020 v2r2 files with original product/version DOI 10.7910/DVN/SWPENT. Modelled spatial disaggregation from agricultural statistics is not a plot-verified crop map, farm ownership or insured sums. Preserve crop and production-system semantics, reference year, source revisions and usage terms; do not use gridded production directly as agricultural policy TIV.

entries.name: Central Bank of Ireland 2025 public SFCR quantitative template repository
entries.spatial_scope: Insurers and reinsurers reporting in Ireland; domicile, underwriting country and insured-risk geography are not interchangeable
entries.temporal_scope: Annual public SFCR repository; published source page includes 2016-2025 reporting years with separately dated files
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Undertaking-level Solvency II public quantitative template data in downloadable year-specific CSV (2025 and earlier); coverage/columns depend on reporting year
entries.note: The regulator publishes annual undertakings' SFCR template repositories; year 2025 appears on its official page. These are public quantitative regulatory disclosures, not proprietary exposure data or complete geocoded insurer portfolios. Check S.05/S.19 and template years, solo/group duplication, gross/net distinctions, entity identities, disclosure suppression and source-specific reuse before modelling.

entries.name: WFP ArcGIS global logistics infrastructure and supply-route services
entries.spatial_scope: Global service collections with country-by-country source coverage and uneven update dates
entries.temporal_scope: Live and periodically updated ArcGIS service inventory observed 2026-11-04; no frozen asset vintage yet
entries.resolution_or_granularity: ArcGIS REST feature services for GlobalPorts, GlobalAirports, GlobalBridges, Warehouses, border crossings, WFP facilities and supply routes
entries.note: The first-party WFP ArcGIS directory exposes multiple distinct facility/transport layers. It may aggregate OpenStreetMap and partner data, so do not assume independent facility observations relative to NGA World Port Index, OSM or other sources. A visible REST service does not establish permission to bulk download, redistribute, commercialise or rely on its points. Capture per-layer description, licence, source vintage, query response and identity before acquisition.

entries.name: Eurostat FIGARO 2026 inter-country input-output and supply-use tables
entries.spatial_scope: EU inter-country and international partner economic flows under the exact FIGARO regional coverage; not physical company or plant locations
entries.resolution_or_granularity: International supply, use and input-output matrices by up to 64 NACE industries and 64 CPA products; CSV/Excel data, related indicators supplied as Parquet
entries.note: FIGARO is a national-accounts industry flow product, not observed firms' logistics contracts or insurance time-element claims. Inter-country input-output linkages need declared price basis, table version, classification, reference year, treatment of imports and economic propagation assumptions. Do not treat aggregate monetary flows as geocoded exposure or insurer-specific contingent BI limits.

entries.name: Open-GIRA reproducible global infrastructure risk analysis workflow
entries.provider: University of Oxford / NISMOD and collaborators
entries.spatial_scope: Country-to-global workflows subject to each chosen OSM, infrastructure and hazard input's coverage
entries.temporal_scope: Actively maintained open-source workflow; results have user-selected input/snapshot dates rather than one global observation vintage
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Snakemake and Python pipeline for roads, rail, electricity network overlays with flood, storm surge and tropical-cyclone hazard, direct damages and indirect interruption
entries.note: This is software and methodology, NOT a new independent source dataset or measured insurer loss. Referenced OSM and hazard outputs retain their original providers and rights. Its Snakemake topology/CI samples can inform reproducible network-loss experiments, but must not be counted as independent infrastructure observations or as validated loss-severity curves.
